exposure: Score for Neonatal Acute Physiology-Perinatal Extension II (SNAPPE-II)
cohort: Neonates with a birth weight of less than 1500 g.
finding: Higher RDW levels on Day 1 and Day 3 post-admission were significantly associated with 28-day mortality in VLBW neonates, with Day 3 RDW showing strong predictive value comparable to SNAPPE-II.
